relationships.subject: AIP
relationships.evidence_quote: inhibitors of CamKII (AIP) and PKCζ (ZIP) were found to interfere with hetLTP

relationships.subject: CamKII
relationships.evidence_quote: CamKII was found to be necessary for both induction and maintenance of hetLTP, whereas PKCζ was only necessary for maintenance

relationships.subject: NMDAR
relationships.evidence_quote: NMDARs) were required for this potentiation

key_findings: In leech, hetLTP of non-nociceptive synapses requires postsynaptic NMDARs, CamKII (induction and maintenance) and PKCζ (maintenance).
hetLTP combines endocannabinoid disinhibition with NMDAR-initiated signaling.
